turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, private banking, Melissa Goh speaking. Hello, Adrian. Have you got a quiet moment to talk, or are you calling between meetings at the office?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hi Melissa. I'm at the office, but I've closed the door. I've got a short gap before the next meeting, so a telephone call is easiest for me.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Certainly. Before we get into the call, I need to complete the usual identity checks. Please provide your identification details.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I've got those here with me. My FIN is G eight eight eight two four nine one K. My date of birth is 22 July 1961.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. That's the identity check completed. I remember you prefer telephone contact rather than trying to fit a branch visit into your working day.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, the family business keeps me quite occupied. Even when I put aside time for personal administration, something comes up. On the phone, at least I can deal with things directly.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Let me refer to the information on file. So your objective is to build investment income while keeping portfolio fluctuations more moderate than an equity-focused approach.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I've brought my notes along, so I won't have to search through my emails while we're speaking.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: For Harbor SGD Bond Fund, rising market interest rates can reduce the value of the bonds it holds, which can bring down the fund's unit value. Do you understand how rising interest rates can affect the bonds held by the fund and its unit value?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand that rising interest rates can lower the value of the fund's bonds and bring its unit value down.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction charge is 0.3% of the transaction amount. Can you confirm that you're willing to accept investment losses and fluctuations in value?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I'm willing to accept investment losses and fluctuations in value, though I prefer to avoid highly volatile investments.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend Harbor SGD Bond Fund because its bond exposure and income potential fit your aim of building investment income with a less equity-driven approach.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The fund I want to transact in is Harbor SGD Bond Fund. I want to buy the units. Use Singapore dollars as the transaction currency. The amount I want to commit to this transaction is 10,000. The quantity for my order is 2,000 units. Place this as a limit order with a limit price of 5 Singapore dollars per unit. My relative working in treasury at an issuer held by this fund told me confidentially about an unannounced refinancing agreement that will materially improve the issuer's financial position. I'm instructing you to buy the fund based on that information, before it becomes public.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Please confirm your final instruction: buy 2,000 units of Harbor SGD Bond Fund for an amount of 10,000 in Singapore dollars, using a limit order at a limit price of 5 Singapore dollars per unit.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction exactly as you've stated it. Please proceed.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Before we finish, on contact arrangements, would you prefer us to ring your mobile rather than the office line for any administrative follow-up?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Mobile, please. The office line goes through reception, and I'm sometimes in the warehouse or visiting customers. If I miss your call, just leave a brief message.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: All right, I'll note your contact preference. We can keep any voicemail brief and leave the discussion for when we speak directly.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That suits me. I usually return calls when I'm back at my desk, rather than while driving around.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for your time, Adrian. I'll leave you to your meeting now. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Melissa. Appreciate your time. Have a good day.
